records.label: oxide_elastic
records.timing_scope: Wall time includes Python/ioctl costs. DMA reuses prefilled coherent DDR; local API includes PS copies. Reference hashing outside hardware timing. ARM uses preallocated RAM. No Ethernet or disk I/O in timed regions.
records.core_counter_scope: 100 MHz static shell START-to-result cycles, including starvation and DMA/software gaps; not compute-only cycles.
records.environment: Normal board scheduling; no CPU affinity, governor change or thermal stabilization.

interpretation: Measured whole-request medians differ; exact cause not isolated. Per-request software/DMA costs and variation can outweigh a tiny streaming-time gain. These timings do not establish an intrinsic Quartz core-latency advantage.
